item.title: Sydney private school accused of mishandling sexual abuse allegations should be banned from enrolling new students, inquiry says
item.description: Inquiry recommends police investigate allegations of sexual assault and other abuse at Redeemer Baptist school Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast An investigation into a private religious school accused of mishandling allegations of sexual, physical, psychological, spiritual and financial abuse has recommended it be barred from enrolling new students. Former students and teachers of western Sydney’s Redeemer Baptist school told a New South Wales parliamentary inquiry about a string of disturbing allegations. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Auckland hit by swarms of bees after milder than usual New Zealand winter
item.description: Beekeepers say they are fielding a record number of calls from people needing assistance in removing swarms Engulfing parked cars and blanketing inner-city street signs – New Zealand’s largest city, Auckland, is in the midst of an unusually large bee swarming season, that experts say has been exacerbated by a milder than usual winter. The Auckland Beekeepers Association says it is fielding five to 10 calls a day, requesting assistance to remove swarms of bees – with individual members of the association being contacted for help as well. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.description: Australian carrier announces agreement with Accenture amid ‘unprecedented’ technological disruption, CEO Vanessa Hudson says Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Qantas is preparing to cut 850 local jobs and outsource work offshore under an AI-driven overhaul, marking a growing wave of disruption to the Australian workforce.
